endpoints.purpose: Mints the ABDM gateway session token that every NHCX call carries, from the client ID and secret issued for Milestone 1.

/v1/coverageeligibility/check.purpose: Provider asks the payer, via NHCX, whether a beneficiary's policy is in force, what it covers and which documents a preauth will need.

/v1/coverageeligibility/on_check.purpose: Payer returns the CoverageEligibilityResponse (policy in force, benefits, auth requirements) or an error to the provider through NHCX.

/internal/v1/coverageeligibility/check.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/coverageeligibility/check with the same JWEPayload body and response set; only the operationId differs.

/internal/v1/coverageeligibility/on_chec.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/coverageeligibility/on_check taking the same bare object body; only the operationId differs.

/v1/preauth/submit.purpose: Provider submits, resubmits, enhances or answers a query on a pre-authorisation Claim bundle (Claim.use preauthorization); NHCX routes it to the payer.

/internal/v1/preauth/submit.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/preauth/submit (operationId preauthSubmitPostInternal) with the same JWEPayload body and response set. Exposed for the NHCX adapter deployment rather than for direct integration.

/v1/preauth/on_submit.purpose: Payer returns the ClaimResponseBundle for a pre-authorisation (approved, partially approved, queried or rejected) to the provider via NHCX.

/internal/v1/preauth/on_submit.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/preauth/on_submit (operationId preauthOnSubmitPostInternal) with the same JWEPayload body and response set. Exposed for the NHCX adapter deployment rather than for direct integration.

/v1/predetermination/submit.purpose: Provider asks the payer what it would approve for a proposed treatment before committing to a pre-authorisation. The bundle has the pre-authorisation's shape with Claim.use predetermination. This is use case B9.

/v1/predetermination/on_submit.purpose: Payer returns its estimate for a predetermination request to the provider: a ClaimResponse with use predetermination and the benefit it would approve. This is use case C11.

/v1/claim/submit.purpose: Provider submits the final itemised Claim bundle (Claim.use claim), or a claim query response or resubmission; NHCX routes it to the payer.

/v1/claim/on_submit.purpose: Payer returns interim (response.partial) and final (response.complete) ClaimResponseBundles for a claim to the provider via NHCX.

/internal/v1/claim/submit.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/claim/submit (operationId claimSubmitPostInternal) with the same JWEPayload body and response set.

/internal/v1/claim/on_submit.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/claim/on_submit (operationId claimOnSubmitPostInternal) taking the same bare object body.

/v1/paymentnotice/request.purpose: Payer pushes a Task bundle with PaymentNotice and PaymentReconciliation (amount, TDS, UTR) to the provider via NHCX after approving a claim.

/internal/v1/paymentnotice/request.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/paymentnotice/request (operationId paymentNoticeRequestPostInternal) with the same JWEPayload body and response set. Exposed for the NHCX adapter deployment rather than for direct integration.

/v1/paymentnotice/on_request.purpose: Provider acknowledges a payment notice with a Task bundle (status completed, output paymentack), closing the payment lifecycle via NHCX.

/internal/v1/paymentnotice/on_request.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/paymentnotice/on_request (operationId paymentNoticeOnRequestPostInternal) with the same JWEPayload body and response set. Exposed for the NHCX adapter deployment rather than for direct integration.

/v1/communication/request.purpose: Payer pushes a Task plus Communication bundle to a provider mid-claim: TAT alerts, wallet or policy changes, grievances or extra-information requests.

/v1/communication/on_request.purpose: Provider returns the acknowledgement Task bundle for a payer communication, echoing the reason code and correlation id so the payer can close the loop.

/internal/v1/communication/request.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/communication/request: same JWEPayload body, description and 202 envelope, operationId communicationRequestPostInternal.

/internal/v1/communication/on_request.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/communication/on_request: the provider acknowledgement Task bundle, operationId communicationOnRequestPostInternal.

/v1/status.purpose: Sender asks NHCX where its own in-flight request stands; the gateway answers request.queued or request.dispatched, and only dispatched yields a callback.

/v1/search/submit.purpose: Authorised entity such as NHA or IRDAI sends a Task to retrieve claim information for a case; the payer returns the documents on the search callback.

/v1/search/on_submit.purpose: Callback returning a search result for task type code=poll; for a claim-document search the payload is the ClaimResponse for the reference number.

/v1/insuranceplan/request.purpose: Provider sends a Task with code poll naming a policy number and/or its HFR id to fetch the payer's machine-readable InsurancePlan for that pairing.

/v1/insuranceplan/on_request.purpose: Payer returns the InsurancePlan collection Bundle (InsurancePlan, Organization, optional Questionnaire) under the request correlation id.

/internal/v1/insuranceplan/request.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/insuranceplan/request on the insuranceplanhcxservice: same TaskBundle payload, same 202 envelope, distinct operationId.

/internal/v1/insuranceplan/on_request.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/insuranceplan/on_request: the payer InsuranceplanBundle callback with identical semantics, distinct operationId.

/get/session.purpose: Exchanges the participant's client_id and client_secret (OAuth 2.0 client credentials) for a Bearer access_token valid for 1200 seconds.

/participant/update.purpose: Updates a participant's registry record; participant_code and roles are mandatory, every other field (certificate, endpoint, contacts, status) is optional.

/v2/participant/update.purpose: Stages a change to a participant encryption certificate and/or endpoint URL; returns a transactionid for passcode confirmation via /update/validate.

/participant/search.purpose: Reads a participant's full registry record by participant_code, including roles, status, encryption_cert and endpoint_url.

/participant/details.purpose: V2 variant of participant search: takes participant_code and returns the matching full registry records.

/fetch/participants/list.purpose: Payer discovery: lists participants filtered by role, registration date window and optional entity type; the first step of the cashless workflow.

/fetch/certs.purpose: Returns a participant's public encryption certificate (PEM X.509 or SPKI key) by participantid; cache it for 24 hours and use it to build the JWE.

/fetch/certs/path.purpose: Companion to /fetch/certs: takes the same participantid body and returns a string described as the participant's certificate path.

/v2/update/cert.purpose: Replaces a participant's public encryption certificate by participantId without passcode validation; the same schema is echoed back on success.

/get/linked/registry/mst.purpose: Internal-use participant-service operation that fetches the linked registry master; listed in the OpenAPI but not intended for integrators.

/participant/link/abha/policy.purpose: Payer-side write that links a beneficiary's ABHA number and member id to one or more products, so provider policy lookups can find them.

/v2/participant/link/abha/policy.purpose: V2 variant of the ABHA policy link; same ParticipantLinkAbhaRequest body and ParticipantLinkAbhaResponse as the unversioned call.

/v2/participant/link/abha/policy/init.purpose: First half of the two-step v2 link: submits the ABHA policy link request, to be confirmed with a passcode via the validate endpoint.

/v2/participant/link/abha/policy/validat.purpose: Second half of the two-step v2 link: confirms an initiated ABHA policy link with the passcode and transactionId query parameters.

/participant/delink/abha/policy.purpose: Removes specific products from a member's policy link for a payer, keyed on payerid, memberid and the products listed.

/v2/participant/delink/abha/policy.purpose: V2 variant of the ABHA policy de-link; same ParticipantDeLinkAbhaRequest body and response as the unversioned call.

/participant/get/policies.purpose: Looks up the policies linked to a beneficiary by ABHA number, member id or mobile number, returning the payer and product details needed for claims.

/v2/participant/get/policies.purpose: V2 variant of the beneficiary policy lookup; same FetchParticipantPoliciesRequest body and ParticipantListResponse as the unversioned call.

/update/abhanumber.purpose: Replaces a placeholder (dummy) ABHA number with the beneficiary's real ABHA number in the ABHA_AUTH_TRANSACTION table.

/product/link.purpose: Registers a product (product id and name) against a payer's participant code, so that it can be referenced in ABHA policy links.

/product/delink.purpose: Removes a product (product id and name) from a payer's participant code in the registry.

/product/getowner.purpose: Resolves a product id to the participant code of the payer that owns it.

/participant/getproductidname.purpose: Retrieving API described as generating the product id and product name; declared with a bare string request body and a participant-code response.

/participant/create.purpose: Creates a participant record in the NHCX registry from a full v1 profile and returns the generated participant_code.

/v2/participant/create.purpose: Registry-linked creation: registry type and ID, role codes, endpoint URL and contacts; returns participantid and a transactionid for /validate.

/v2/participant/hementity/create.purpose: Creates a hospital (HEM-entity) participant from the full empanelment payload (bank, tax, beds, specialities, doctors); returns status and hospitalid.

/validate.purpose: Confirms a participant creation by presenting the SMS passcode and the transactionId returned by /v2/participant/create.

/update/validate.purpose: Confirms a participant update by presenting the SMS passcode and the transactionId returned by /v2/participant/update.

/process/request.purpose: Makes the sandbox dummy payer, participant 1000003538@hcx, approve, reject or query a pre-authorisation or claim you have submitted, by correlation ID.

/paymentnotice/init.purpose: Makes the sandbox dummy payer send a payment notice to the provider named, on /v1/paymentnotice/request.

/v1/task/submit.purpose: Provider sends a FHIR Task asking the payer to reprocess a rejected or short-paid claim or to cancel a preauth; Task.code and reasonCode set the intent.

/v1/task/on_submit.purpose: Payer returns a Task bundle with Task.status completed whose Task.output references a ClaimResponse carrying the reprocess or cancellation outcome.

/internal/v1/task/submit.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/task/submit on the taskhcxservice, operationId hcxTaskPostInternal, with the same JWEPayload Task body and 202 envelope.

/internal/v1/task/on_submit.purpose: Internal twin of /v1/task/on_submit (hcxOnTaskPostInternal): the payer Task bundle wrapping the ClaimResponse outcome of a reprocess or cancel.

/v1/notification/subscribe.purpose: A Beneficiary Service Provider (PHR app) subscribes an ABHA id to notification topics; NHCX persists it synchronously, Last-Linked-Wins per ABHA id.

/v1/notification/on_subscribe.purpose: BSP-side subscription acknowledgement; the same name denotes the callback where NHCX pushes claim-event notifications for a subscribed ABHA id.

/v1/delete.purpose: Internal troubleshooting operation on the claim service that deletes records by correlationid and action; not part of the business transaction flows.

/v3/api-docs.purpose: Serves the status service's OpenAPI 3 document, optionally filtered by a group query parameter; a discovery endpoint, not a protocol API.

/v2/api-docs.purpose: Serves the status service's Swagger 2 document, optionally filtered by a group query parameter; a discovery endpoint, not a protocol API.

/swagger-resources.purpose: Lists the Swagger resources (API document locations) exposed by the status service; used by Swagger UI, not by integrations.

/swagger-resources/configuration/ui.purpose: Returns the Swagger UI display configuration for the status service; consumed by Swagger UI, not by integrations.

/swagger-resources/configuration/securit.purpose: Returns the Swagger UI security configuration for the status service; consumed by Swagger UI, not by integrations.

/v1/on_status.purpose: The answer to a status request, delivered to the sender that asked. The x-hcx-status in the protected header says where the message you asked about got to. The payload is an empty string.

/v1/error.purpose: Where the exchange tells a sender that a request could not be delivered after five attempts. Received by every participant under its registered address. There is no outbound form.

/abha/biometric/auth/init.purpose: Starts a fingerprint or iris authentication of a PMJAY beneficiary against the ABHA registry and returns the txnId the verify call needs.

/abha/biometric/auth/verify.purpose: Completes the authentication started by Biometric auth init with the captured PID block, and returns the beneficiary's user token, valid thirty minutes.

/abha/biometric/auth/refresh/token.purpose: Exchanges the refresh token from Biometric auth verify for a new thirty-minute user token without a fresh capture.

/abha/biometric/faceauth/init.purpose: Starts a face authentication on the ABDM proxy host and returns the txnId the rest of the face flow quotes.

/abha/biometric/capture/pid.purpose: Polls for the face capture the patient completes in the ABHA app after scanning the QR code for the txnId from Face auth init.

/abha/biometric/v2/auth/verify.purpose: Completes a face authentication with the encrypted Aadhaar number, the Aadhaar-linked mobile and the txnId, and returns the beneficiary's user token.

ABDM.definition: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission. The national digital health programme under which NHCX is built.

SNOMED CT.definition: The clinical, diagnosis and laboratory terminologies FHIR bundles carry, alongside the NRCeS value sets for claim-specific codes.

ICD.definition: The clinical, diagnosis and laboratory terminologies FHIR bundles carry, alongside the NRCeS value sets for claim-specific codes.

LOINC.definition: The clinical, diagnosis and laboratory terminologies FHIR bundles carry, alongside the NRCeS value sets for claim-specific codes.

NHA.definition: National Health Authority. Publishes the NHCX specifications, runs the exchange, and administers PMJAY.

NRCeS.definition: National Resource Centre for EHR Standards, at C-DAC Pune. Publishes the FHIR profiles and value sets NHCX bundles must follow.

IRDAI.definition: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India. Consulted on the specifications; the registry insurers and TPAs are identified by.

PMJAY.definition: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana, the Ayushman Bharat health assurance scheme. On NHCX it is a payer with scheme-specific rules.

SHA.definition: State Health Agency. Administers PMJAY in a state; under the trust model, the payer for that state.

TPA.definition: Third-party administrator. Processes claims on an insurer's behalf; on the network it behaves as a payer and is the processor for the policies it handles.

ISNP.definition: Insurance self-network platform; an insurance marketplace, a participant role with aggregated or consented data access.

BSP.definition: Beneficiary service provider, end-user application. A patient's personal health record app registered as a participant to receive notifications.

EUA.definition: Beneficiary service provider, end-user application. A patient's personal health record app registered as a participant to receive notifications.

TMS.definition: Transaction Management System. NHA's provider and payer applications for PMJAY claims; the system an HMIS integration replaces on the provider side.

BIS.definition: Beneficiary Identification System. PMJAY's beneficiary register.

HEM.definition: Hospital Empanelment Module. PMJAY's hospital register; the HEM ID is mapped to the NHCX participant ID at go-live.

PPD.definition: Preauthorisation Processing Doctor. The payer-side role that adjudicates preauthorisations.

CPD.definition: Claim Processing Doctor. The payer-side role that adjudicates claims.

CRC.definition: Claim Review Committee. Decides appeals; its decision is final.

HBP.definition: Health Benefit Package. PMJAY's package master, from which a hospital's insurance plan is drawn.

STG.definition: Standard Treatment Guideline. A clinical protocol attached to a package, delivered as a questionnaire the provider must answer.

ABHA.definition: Ayushman Bharat Health Account. The beneficiary's health ID; sent without hyphens.

HFR.definition: Health Facility Registry. A hospital's registry; its HFR ID is the hospital's registry ID on the exchange.

NIN.definition: Other registries a participant may be identified by.

ROHINI.definition: Other registries a participant may be identified by.

Registry ID.definition: A participant's identity in the registry it belongs to: HFR ID for a hospital, IRDAI ID for an insurer or TPA, client ID for an app.

Participant ID.definition: A participant's address on the exchange, in the form 1518@hcx. The part after the @ names the exchange instance.

participant code.definition: A participant's address on the exchange, in the form 1518@hcx. The part after the @ names the exchange instance.

Client ID and secret.definition: The ABDM credentials used to obtain an access token; the same ones issued for Milestone 1.

Milestone 1.definition: The ABDM integration level, ABHA creation and verification, that must be complete before NHCX.

M1.definition: The ABDM integration level, ABHA creation and verification, that must be complete before NHCX.

Bridge URL.definition: The base address of a participant's callback server, registered on its participant record.

endpoint URL.definition: The base address of a participant's callback server, registered on its participant record.

Passcode.definition: The one-time code sent to a participant's registered mobile to confirm creation or configuration in production.

Processor.definition: The participant that processes claims for a policy: the insurer itself or its TPA. The recipient of every claim-side message.

processingid.definition: The participant that processes claims for a policy: the insurer itself or its TPA. The recipient of every claim-side message.

Payer ID.definition: The insurer's own participant code, named inside the bundle as the insurer.

payerid.definition: The insurer's own participant code, named inside the bundle as the insurer.

Member ID.definition: The beneficiary's identifier on the policy.

NPI.definition: Identifier types for a provider's HFR ID and a payer's registry ID inside a bundle.

NIIP.definition: Identifier types for a provider's HFR ID and a payer's registry ID inside a bundle.

WASA.definition: The security audit completed before ABDM production access.

HTC demo.definition: The demonstration before NRCeS, IRDAI, TCS and NHA that closes sandbox certification.

JWE.definition: JSON Web Encryption. The sealed-envelope format every message uses.

JWT.definition: JSON Web Token. The format of the access token and of the signature the exchange puts on calls to a participant.

Envelope.definition: The readable part of a message: the x-hcx- fields and the encryption settings.

protected header.definition: The readable part of a message: the x-hcx- fields and the encryption settings.

Letter.definition: The FHIR bundle inside the envelope, encrypted for the receiver.

payload.definition: The FHIR bundle inside the envelope, encrypted for the receiver.

Domain headers.definition: A few facts written on the envelope for the exchange's records, such as an amount.

Correlation ID.definition: The number that ties a request and its answers into one conversation.

API call ID.definition: Fresh identifiers for one call and one request.

request ID.definition: Fresh identifiers for one call and one request.

Workflow code.definition: The number in the envelope that says which step of the claim a message is.

workflow ID.definition: The number in the envelope that says which step of the claim a message is.

Status word.definition: The x-hcx-status value: request.initiated, response.partial, response.complete, response.error, and the exchange's own request.queued, request.dispatched, request.stopped.

Receipt.definition: The 202 Accepted body returned on taking a message in. Not a decision.

Protocol response.definition: A refusal returned on the callback with response.error and error details, when a message could not be opened or failed validation.

Callback.definition: The endpoint a participant hosts to receive answers and payer-initiated messages.

Dummy payer.definition: The sandbox payer, participant 1000003538@hcx, that answers the provider exchanges listed in the NHCX Use Cases chapter.

Preauthorisation.definition: Approval to treat, sought before treatment. A Claim with use = preauthorization.

preauth.definition: Approval to treat, sought before treatment. A Claim with use = preauthorization.

Enhancement.definition: Additional procedures or days sought against an approved preauthorisation.

Resubmission.definition: A revised preauthorisation that replaces an earlier one.

Query.definition: The payer asking for more before it decides. The case stays open.

Claim.definition: The request for payment after discharge. A Claim with use = claim.

Predetermination.definition: Asking what a payer would approve, without committing.

Adjudication.definition: The payer's decision on a preauthorisation or claim.

Reprocess.definition: An appeal against a rejection, raised as a Task.

Shortfall.definition: A request for the difference when a claim was paid short, raised as a Task after payment settles, under reason partialpayment.

Erroneous claim.definition: In the value set, a separate reason, erroneousclaim, for a reprocess caused by a mistaken submission by the provider. The FAQ uses the phrase for the shortfall case; the two senses coexist in the corpus.

Task.definition: The general-purpose request resource: plan fetch, cancel, reprocess, search, payment notice, acknowledgement, communication.

Communication.definition: A payer-initiated message outside the claim's own request-and-answer: a TAT alert, a grievance, a wallet or policy change, a request for information.

TAT.definition: Turnaround time. The window within which a payer is expected to act; under some policies, silence within it means approval.

Wallet.definition: The beneficiary's remaining cover under PMJAY, shared across the family.

Package.definition: A treatment with a fixed rate under a scheme; the unit a PMJAY claim is built from.

Stratification.definition: A higher bed category, such as ICU or HDU, allowed as an add-on over a package rate.

Implant.definition: A device allowed as an add-on over a package rate.

Unspecified procedure.definition: A treatment not in the package list, allowed under conditions with a free-text name and amount.

Cyclic procedure.definition: A treatment approved once and delivered over several visits, such as dialysis.

LAMA.definition: Leave against medical advice, without informing the hospital; discharge against medical advice, with a signed undertaking. Two of the four discharge types, with DTH (home) and DTM (death).

DAMA.definition: Leave against medical advice, without informing the hospital; discharge against medical advice, with a signed undertaking. Two of the four discharge types, with DTH (home) and DTM (death).

LM100.definition: The single line item for a LAMA or DAMA stay before surgery, in place of the approved packages.

UTR.definition: Unique transaction reference. The bank's reference for a payment, carried on the payment reconciliation.

TDS.definition: Tax deducted at source, itemised on the payment reconciliation.

x-hcx-recipient_code.definition: The recipient's. For a provider, the processor code from the policy lookup

x-hcx-api_call_id.definition: Fresh on every message, including responses

x-hcx-request_id.definition: One per originating request. The Open Protocol page marks it Mandatory; the Technical Specifications page marks it Optional

x-hcx-correlation_id.definition: The thread. See the rule below

x-hcx-workflow_id.definition: Which step, or which case. See the two readings below

x-hcx-status.definition: Where this message stands. Values below

x-hcx-ben-abha-id.definition: The beneficiary's ABHA number. Mandatory on every exchange, including those with no beneficiary in the payload

x-hcx-use_case.definition: Values differ by exchange, see below

x-hcx-error_details.definition: code, message, trace. Mandatory on a protocol response

x-hcx-debug_flag.definition: Error, Info or Debug. A server may ignore it

x-hcx-amount_submitted.definition: The amount submitted by the provider

x-hcx-benefit-category_type.definition: The benefit category, meaning the specialty

x-hcx-benefit_code.definition: An array of the benefits or services submitted

x-hcx-action.definition: The event type, such as preauth_response
